description: Shared cross-sector ontology for competitor intelligence. Domain profiles extend, but do not redefine, the canonical entity and relationship IDs.

entityTypes.organization: A company, agency, bank, payment network, regulator, NGO, supplier or other institution
entityTypes.person: A person explicitly named in the source text
entityTypes.product_service: A named product, service, card, program, platform or commercial offering
entityTypes.location: A place explicitly mentioned in the content
entityTypes.region: A country, state, province, city-region or other geographic market
entityTypes.customer_segment: A type of customer, buyer, member, cardholder or user
entityTypes.technology: A technology, software platform, AI capability or technical standard
entityTypes.standard_regulation: A law, regulation, standard, certification scheme or compliance requirement
entityTypes.event: A launch, partnership, acquisition, incident, award, expansion, outage or other dated development
entityTypes.issue: A complaint, operational failure, unmet need, risk or recurring customer problem
entityTypes.competitor: An organization treated as a market competitor in the current domain
entityTypes.hashtag: A hashtag explicitly present in the source post
entityTypes.x_account: An X account explicitly mentioned or identified as an author

relationTypes.announced: Organization announced an event, change or initiative
relationTypes.launched: Organization introduced a product, service or capability
relationTypes.offers: Organization offers a product or service
relationTypes.partners_with: Two organizations entered or announced a partnership
relationTypes.acquired: One organization acquired another organization or asset
relationTypes.operates_in: Organization explicitly operates in a market or region
relationTypes.located_in: Entity is explicitly located in a place
relationTypes.certified_by: Product, organization or process was certified by an organization
relationTypes.regulated_by: Organization or product is subject to a named regulator or regulation
relationTypes.affects: Issue or event affects an entity, service, user group or market
relationTypes.experienced_by: A complaint or issue was experienced by a user or customer segment
relationTypes.reported_from: A complaint or report explicitly originates from a region
relationTypes.responded_to: Organization publicly responded to a complaint or issue
relationTypes.resolved_by: Issue was explicitly resolved by an organization or action
relationTypes.competes_with: Organizations compete in a stated market or service
relationTypes.mentions_account: Post explicitly mentions an X account
relationTypes.replies_to: A post is a reply to another post
relationTypes.evidenced_by: An analysis claim is supported by one or more source records

neverInfer: customer identity from a handle unless explicitly relevant and public
a service failure from negative sentiment alone
a competitor gap from one isolated complaint
